title: All empty dictionaries in resources loaded from disk point to the same object in memory
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 10 Jun 2025 21:32:33 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA RTX A500 Laptop GPU (nvidia; 575.57.08) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1370P (20 threads)

### Issue description

In my game I have a main screen plugin, which loads some resources from disk and presents wigdets to modify them. I noticed that when multiple `.tres` files contain an empty dictionary, these dictionaries are loaded all as a single object in memory. So when I add an entry to one of these empty dictionaries, I can see that entry present in all of them. I suppose this is a bug, or is there some very unusual caching strategy employed here?

### Steps to reproduce

See MRP:
There are two resource files: `resource_a.tres` and `resource_b.tres`. Each of them contains an empty dictionary as `data`. These resources are loaded by a main screen plugin when the Godot editor is started.

In Godot Editor, in the main screen plugin selector, select "Plugin". The plugin presents two buttons for adding random entries to dictionaries in Resources A and B. You can observe in the console output that, as you add random elements, both dictionaries always contain the same entries in the same order.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[dictionary_bug_mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20755517/dictionary_bug_mrp.zip)
